description: Defines classes and methods for decoding preloaded data entries, including bit and Huffman decoding, used in network data processing within Chromium project.

classes.name: PreloadDecoder
classes.description: Base class for decoding preloaded network data, including trie-based decoding and entry resolution.

classes.name: PreloadDecoder::BitReader
classes.description: Handles bit-by-bit reading from a byte stream, including decoding variable-length size values.

classes.name: PreloadDecoder::HuffmanDecoder
classes.description: Decodes Huffman-encoded data using a simple tree structure.

methods.name: PreloadDecoder(const uint8_t* huffman_tree, size_t huffman_tree_size, const uint8_t* trie, size_t trie_bits, size_t trie_root_position)
methods.description: Constructor initializing Huffman and trie data for decoding.

methods.name: bool Decode(const std::string& search, bool* out_found)
methods.description: Decodes a search key against preloaded trie data to find relevant entries.

methods.name: virtual bool ReadEntry(BitReader* reader, const std::string& search, size_t current_search_offset, bool* out_found) = 0
methods.description: Abstract method to read an entry from the preloaded data, to be implemented by subclasses.
